pages.title: Accounts and passwords
pages.description: Change the web login names and passwords.
pages.notes: OBJ_USERINFO_ID -> DevAuthInfo, with OBJ Type=AppID, Right=Level, Username=User, Password=Pass (confirmed by the reference firmware usermgr lua). Web accounts are AppID 1: row 0 admin (Level 1), row 1 user (Level 2). Rows 2-5 have AppID 2/4/5 (other services, purpose unverified) and are not shown. Stock handler: when the admin edits its own row it first verifies the old password with login(); editing the user row needs no old password; a user can edit only row 1. Stock length 0-256, chars 1-255, new == confirm. Changing the admin password affects the stock web UI and the telnet.gch check. manager_user_conf_t.gch (right=2) is the user-level variant of the same page.

pages.title: Restart and reset
pages.description: Restart the router, restore factory settings, back up or restore the configuration.

actions.label: Restart device
actions.note: Stock: POST manager_dev_conf_t.gch IF_ACTION=devrestart -> equip_gch.gch dev_action(CmdId=cmd_devrestart) (cspd). ajaxComLogic.gch IF_ACTION=devRestart does the same. Replacement: save DB (sidbg 1 DB save) then busybox reboot; already implemented as /api/action/reboot.

actions.label: Restore factory settings
actions.note: Stock: IF_ACTION=devrestoreR -> dev_action(CmdId=cmd_factoryreset); cspd marks RESTORE default and reboots, loading /userconfig/cfg/db_default_cfg.xml. (IF_ACTION=devrestore -> cmd_devrestore exists but the page does not use it.) No shell equivalent is proven: either call the stock webd endpoint, or remove db_user_cfg.xml and db_backup_cfg.xml from /userconfig/cfg and reboot (fw_flashing does this unlink on a protocol change; cspd then loads the default). Verify with a full-flash backup first. Resets the admin password and Wi-Fi.

actions.label: Download configuration
actions.note: No web config backup on this stock build (only USB). Replacement: stream /userconfig/cfg/db_user_cfg.xml (ecb-zero DB container, AES-128-ECB zero key, decodable with zte670 unpack-db); already implemented as /api/backup/download. The file contains every secret in the DB.

actions.label: Restore configuration
actions.note: Replacement (proven by hand, README): validate the uploaded file decodes as a DB container, write it to /userconfig/cfg/db_user_cfg.xml and db_backup_cfg.xml, then reboot. Never sidbg DB save after writing (it would overwrite the file with the running DB). Stock alternative: USB restore (admin-usb-restore). httpd also has ConfigUpload/DefCfgUpload upload types via getpage.gch, unused by any page here.

pages.notes: Factory reset is shown only to Right=1 (admin). manager_dev_conf_t_user.gch (right=2) offers reboot only. After either action the stock page waits and AutoRelogin()s.

pages.title: Firmware upgrade

actions.label: Upload and install firmware
actions.note: Stock: multipart POST to getpage.gch?pid=100&<csrf token> with file field VersionUpload (token from get_csrf_session_token, checked first via checkSessionToken.gch). getpage.gch is internal to httpd: it refuses if Content-Length exceeds free memory, writes /var/tmp/fw.bin and calls CmUpgradeStart (pm_upgrade_start) -> cspd upgrade_mgr. cspd checks the image (UpgradeCheckUpgradeFile, verifyCspFwMagic, "zxic_Header"/firmware header, dwWhichDefault, UpgradeCheckUpgradeKey), kills processes, runs `fw_flashing -d %d -r %d -p %ld -t %d -f /var/tmp/fw.bin` (bootloader: boot_flashing), which checks magic, board type and software version, writes the inactive image bank (dual image, Image0Status/Image1Status) and reboots. Progress: OBJ_UPGRADE_ID UpgardeStatus (SUCC / UPLOAD_FINISH / REBOOTING) and Percent (508 = specific error upg_508). Replacement: hand the file to the stock path (POST to webd, or copy to /var/tmp/fw.bin and trigger cspd) rather than flashing mtd directly. fw_flashing details are from the reference firmware (ref-fw-v9) and the clone cspd strings; the clone fw_flashing binary was not examined.

pages.notes: OBJ_UPGRADE_ID is runtime (status DM is spelled UpgardeStatus). This device is a clone with no replacement firmware available (README); a wrong image can brick it, so keep a full-flash backup (backup/firmware). Version strings: /proc/csp/softVersion.

pages.title: USB backup
pages.description: Save the configuration to a USB disk.

actions.label: Back up to USB
actions.note: Stock writes OBJ_USBBAKRST_ID {SelectPath=<USB mount path>, StartBackup=1} with set_inst and undoDBSave (runtime trigger). cspd writes <path>/<UsbBakRst.BakDir>/<UsbBakRst.BakFileName> (firmware default dir e8_Config_Backup, file ctce8_<model>.cfg) in the ctce8 cfg format that zte670 pack/unpack handles. USB storages come from OBJ_USBBACKUPSTORAGE_ID {ViewName, Path, BakFileExist}.

pages.notes: Stock writes OBJ_USBBAKRST_ID {SelectPath=<USB mount path>, StartBackup=1} with set_inst and undoDBSave (runtime trigger). cspd writes <path>/<UsbBakRst.BakDir>/<UsbBakRst.BakFileName> (firmware default dir e8_Config_Backup, file ctce8_<model>.cfg) in the ctce8 cfg format that zte670 pack/unpack handles. USB storages come from OBJ_USBBACKUPSTORAGE_ID {ViewName, Path, BakFileExist}.

pages.title: USB restore
pages.description: Restore the configuration from a USB disk at the next boot.
pages.notes: At boot cspd (dbFileUSBRestore) checks RstEnable, opens /mnt/<usb>/<BakDir>/<BakFileName>, verifies version/sign headers, decrypts, decompresses and compares; on success it replaces the user config. Stock: "takes effect only after the device reboots". Menu right=3.

pages.title: System log
pages.description: Log level, the current log, and log download.

actions.label: Download log
actions.note: Stock: multipart POST getpage.gch?pid=101&<csrf token> with field downloadlog; httpd calls pm_log_get_log_file and returns it as log_file.log (strings suggest /var/userlog.txt). Logs also live in /var/log/tmplog1 and /userconfig/cfg/log.

pages.notes: OBJ_LOG_ID -> Log. Stock reads the log text with show_log() in a loop. Stock applies through cspd set_inst (module notified live). A sidbg DB set+save does not notify the module, so assume the change needs a reboot until verified. UI-text notes moved here: [ServiceEnable]: In the handler, not on the stock page.

pages.title: Maintenance complete
pages.description: Tell the operator management system that on-site maintenance is finished.
pages.applicableNote: Operator (ITMS/TR-069) maintenance workflow; no effect expected without an ACS.

pages.title: Service account numbers
pages.description: Operator account numbers for broadband, IPTV and VoIP.
pages.applicableNote: Operator provisioning data; informational on a retail unit.
pages.notes: OBJ_DEVINFO_ID -> DevInfo. These may hold operator account numbers; never copy values. Menu right=3. Stock applies through cspd set_inst (module notified live). A sidbg DB set+save does not notify the module, so assume the change needs a reboot until verified.

pages.title: VoIP protocol
pages.description: Choose SIP or H.248. The router restarts after a change.
pages.notes: OBJ_VOIPEXT_ID -> VOIPExt. Stock: after a successful apply that changes the protocol (compared with getenv VoIPProtocal: 1=H248, 2=MGCP, 4=SIP), the page posts ajaxComLogic.gch?pid=1 IF_ACTION=devRestart. fw_flashing also writes /userconfig/cfg/protocol_flag.file and clears the user DB on a media-protocol change during upgrade. The menu then hides the other protocol pages.

pages.title: Indicator lights
pages.description: Turn the front-panel LEDs off or on.
pages.notes: OBJ_LED_CONTROL_ID LedControl (1 = off) is not a DB column: httpd webd_adaptor_pon_led_control.c calls pm_pdt_get_leds_status / pm_pdt_ctl_leds. Persistence across reboot unverified (cspd has LedCtl_Recover and LedTimeCfg/LedTime tables for scheduled LED off). Menu right=3.

pages.title: Loop detection
pages.description: Detect Ethernet loops on the LAN ports and shut the looping port.

fields.label: Ethernet type
fields.help: Ethernet type of the loop-detection frame, entered as a decimal number (0–65535).

fields.label: Send interval
fields.help: How often detection frames are sent, in milliseconds (1000–5000).

fields.label: VLANs
fields.help: Comma-separated, up to 10 VLAN IDs, each 1-4094.

pages.notes: OBJ_BACKLOOP_ID {DMac, Ethertype, LoopbackEnable, VidStr, Sendinterval, RenewTime, CheckInterval} mapped to LoopbackGlobalConf {DMACAddr, EtherType, Enable, VlanTag, SendInterval, RenewTime, CheckInterval} by name (verify, especially units). The Ports section (LoopbackEthConf, 6 rows) is not on the stock page. Menu right=3. Stock applies through cspd set_inst (module notified live). A sidbg DB set+save does not notify the module, so assume the change needs a reboot until verified. UI-text notes moved here: [EtherType]: Stock shows hex 0x0000-0xffff; stored as decimal. | [SendInterval]: Stock edits 1-5 s; the DB value suggests milliseconds (verify).

pages.title: Telnet
pages.notes: Telnet is the recovery path for this device (root shell, the toolkit and the adminui deploy use it). Disabling LAN telnet leaves only this UI and a full-flash restore. The stock menu entry smTelnetMgr has no page; the security menu page tele_sec_tserver_t.gch (OBJ_TSERVER_CONF_ID {TS_Enable, Wan_Enable, Lan_Enable}) edits the same table. Separately, stock telnet.gch enables LAN telnet for anyone presenting a hard-coded credential in the query string (an unauthenticated backdoor; the replacement should not reproduce it). TelnetUser rows: LAN and WAN. Stock applies through cspd set_inst (module notified live). A sidbg DB set+save does not notify the module, so assume the change needs a reboot until verified.

pages.title: Monitoring collector
pages.applicableNote: Operator monitoring feature used by some ISPs only.
pages.notes: OBJ_PONMONITORCONFIG_ID {Enable, ServerUrl, TftpPort, MonitorNumberOfEntries} -> MonitorCollectorCfg (MONITORCONFIG also has an Enable column; which one is used is unverified). Stock inputs for URL and port are disabled. Stock applies through cspd set_inst (module notified live). A sidbg DB set+save does not notify the module, so assume the change needs a reboot until verified. UI-text notes moved here: [applicableNote]: Province-specific operator feature (menu under Diagnostics; anhui_monitor_config_t.gch is a variant).
